description: Search Rightmove for properties for sale or to rent, or fetch any Rightmove listing page by URL.

includeSSTC.description: Include properties that are Sold Subject To Contract (SSTC) or Let Agreed.
includeSSTC.title: Include Sold STC / Let Agreed

location.description: City, town, or region name (e.g. `London`, `Manchester`, `Leeds`). Used in modes `forSale` and `toRent`.
location.title: Location

maxBedrooms.description: Maximum number of bedrooms. Leave blank for no maximum.
maxBedrooms.title: Max bedrooms

maxItems.description: Maximum number of property records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Maximum property price in GBP. Leave blank for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Max price (GBP)

minPrice.description: Minimum property price in GBP. Leave blank for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Min price (GBP)

mode.description: Scraping mode: search properties for sale, to rent, or fetch a specific listing page URL.
enumTitles: For Sale — search properties for sale
By URL — fetch a Rightmove listing or search page URL
mode.title: Mode

propertyType.description: Restrict results to a specific property type. Leave blank for all types.
propertyType.title: Property type filter

radius.description: Search radius around the location in miles.
radius.title: Search radius (miles)

startUrls.description: One or more Rightmove search or listing page URLs. Used in mode `byUrl`.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (mode=byUrl)

title: Rightmove Property Scraper Input
